## Course Description

DATA100 introduces students to the practice of data analysis: how to formulate questions, work with data in R, and communicate findings clearly and responsibly.

## Instructor

**Agassi Iu**
Wilfrid Laurier University
**Office Hours:** Wednesdays 14:00–16:00, LH3073, or by appointment

## Assessments & Evaluation

| Category | Weight | Frequency |
|---|:---:|---|
| **Laboratories** | 30% | Weekly on Mondays |
| **Participation** | 5% | Every class |
| **Capstone Project** | 15% | Multiple due-dates |
| **Midterm Exams** | 20% | Twice (see [Schedule](schedule.qmd)) |
| **Final Exam** | 20% | Final exam period in December |

## Tools

- **R & RStudio** — all labs, assignments, and even exams use R.
- **MyLearningSpace** — announcements, submissions, and discussions.

## Policies

::: {.callout-note}
## In-Class
- Be respectful to the instructor and your fellow classmates.
- Laptops/tablets are welcome for note-taking and participation only.
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Out-of-Class
- Start assignments early — technical work takes time to debug.
- Academic integrity and independent work are expected.
:::

::: {.callout-warning}
## Artificial Intelligence
See [Laurier's Generative AI Policy](https://www.wlu.ca/about/governance/senior-leadership/vice-president-academic/generative-artificial-intelligence/index.html).

My own policy: spend at least **15 minutes** diagnosing a problem yourself before turning to AI tools. Later in the course, using AI will actually be a *required* component of the final project.
:::

## First-Year Success Tips

- **Start early** — avoid last-minute coding stress.
- **Practice daily** — even 30 minutes a day beats cramming.
- **Ask questions early** — reach out after 15 minutes of being stuck. Use office hours.
- **Form study groups** — accountability helps.
